text: At 2.1.14 `m22dserv` says all three renderers compose their text from the same three blocks — the `Server required — for every step` section, the `Stale address — PROJECT_NOT_IN_WORKSPACE` section parameterized by publicUrl and id, and the quoted identity `--server '<publicUrl>' --project '<id>'` on every command — and that `workspace` reaches no part of any skill's text; a change to any block changes all three skills at once and concerns all three exact-text pages. The exact-text pages of c4s-brief-implementer and c4s-refactor were not updated in this window: their preambles still substitute `<workspace>` → `ctx.workspace`, their bodies still say `project <id> in workspace <workspace>`, show the identity unquoted (`--server <publicUrl> --project <id>`), carry their own SERVER_NOT_RUNNING / PROJECT_NOT_IN_WORKSPACE paragraphs instead of the shared sections, and keep thread continuation lines. Assumed: `m22dserv` (the changed, normative section) wins — the brief-implementer and refactor renderers emit the shared Server required and Stale address blocks and the quoted identity, and never the workspace, as the code already did; their remaining text follows their pages.
assumption: ASSUMPTION:m22-dev-0002 — brief-implementer and refactor follow m22dserv's shared blocks, not their stale exact-text pages.
